title: Mushroom Risotto
description: A slow-stirred, savory risotto for a relaxed evening.

cooking_instructions.text: Warm the stock in a saucepan and keep it at a low simmer.
Sauté the sliced mushrooms until golden, then set them aside.
Toast the rice, then add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 20 minutes.
Stir in the mushrooms, cream and parmesan, then rest for 2 minutes before serving.
